command:
unset PYTHONPATH; echo -n 'wheel env: '; $SC/cleanwheel/bin/python -m pip list --format=freeze | tr '
' ' '; echo; cd $SC && $SC/cleanwheel/bin/python $SC/import_sweep.py; echo 'wheel sweep exit='$?; echo -n 'sdist env: '; $SC/cleansdist/bin/python -m pip list --format=freeze | tr '
' ' '; echo; $SC/cleansdist/bin/python $SC/import_sweep.py; echo 'sdist sweep exit='$?; for v in $SC/cleanwheel $SC/cleansdist; do $v/bin/python -c "import numpy as np; from mixle.inference import optimize; from mixle.stats import GaussianEstimator; m=optimize(list(np.random.RandomState(0).normal(0,1,200)), GaussianEstimator(), max_its=5, out=None); print(' fit:', round(float(m.mu),9), round(float(m.sigma2),9))"; done; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$SC/check-runs.json'));r=[x for p in d for x in p['check_runs']];sel=[x for x in r if x['name']=='clean-wheel install + import sweep' and x['conclusion']!='cancelled'];print('
'.join('%s: %s/%s (id=%s)' % (x['name'],x['status'],x['conclusion'],x['id']) for x in sel))"
gate: Clean wheel and sdist import/behavior sweep
note: The hosted lane ran in tests.yml's workflow_dispatch run 35060101092 on this commit, which superseded the push run; that run's copy of the lane shows as cancelled.
result: both the wheel and the sdist install into fresh venvs (numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1) and sweep all 810 public modules cleanly; a Gaussian fit on the same 200 rows returns identical parameters from both installs (mu 0.070910493, sigma2 1.043304472); the hosted 'clean-wheel install + import sweep' lane is completed/success on this commit (check run 104678472200)
